in_marathi.name: Baidehi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of beauty and wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baidehi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baidehi is a beautiful and elegant name derived from the Sanskrit language. This name is associated with the goddess of beauty, wealth, and prosperity. It is believed that Baidehi symbolizes the divine feminine energy and bestows grace, charm, and abundance upon those who bear this name.
